brief: We screened 1,307 parcels and identified four priority private sites ready for outreach this week where owners are flagged motivated and mailing records are in place. Three Brooklyn targets share an owner holding eight lots on the board, offering prime portfolio acquisition potential under 485-x Option C and City of Yes UAP. All four targets pencil with headroom ranging from 1.30 to 2.09 above estimated comps, ensuring strong downside protection.

targets.negotiation: Estimated land is $465,864 with a max offer of $512,450, supported by 1.30 headroom against a builder walk-away value of $604,126.
targets.risk: Verify sewer availability and site condition before dispatching the letter.
